taxonomy_guards.rule: Seven DTG Core Credential concrete types in published Working Draft 0.6.0: VMC, VRC, VDC, VIC, VPC, VSC and VAC. The VEC/VWC are VSC predicate profiles, not credential types. Edge credential grouping of VMC/VRC/VDC is descriptive and not an intermediate schema type.
An IDVC can support DTG onboarding but is not one of the standard DTG Core Credentials
An r-card is a VDS, not a DTGCredential subtype
Credential taskContext binding does not authorize rewriting an existing TIG trust-task definition or treating a Trust Task artifact as a credential
